title: Construct a shorter G20 word: 245 fewer ADDs per call with exact endpoints
body:
The actual PR5708 G20 word now uses **245 fewer ADDs per local call**, with the same complete endpoint and every native/owned boundary value. Its 18-call context can remove 4,410 ADDs and 8,820 primitive-count terms. The local positive majorant falls from 3,189,524 to 2,653,582. The recursive paid/target profile is unchanged; no new kappa is claimed.

The construction applies the exact PR5793 synthesis tool to 191 actual windows over three rounds. A dynamic program chooses the best disjoint window cover in each pass. Every two-, three- and four-role endpoint has a certified minimum word; a final complete pass has no strict reduction. Neutral rewrites, larger windows and changed native frames remain outside this fixed point.

The package includes the new WORD, exact EDITS, complete receipt, source pins, unchanged tool bytes, proof and controls. All 685 arbitrary input axes, 48 dirty owned axes, native frames, target boundaries and owned clears are retained. Forward and reverse full-word interpreters agree; a literal truth-table check independently validates each rewrite. Registered normal/optimized checks and read-only Git-free replay pass. Source and semantic corruption controls reject. Hosted scientific replay and independent acceptance are pending.

The proof permits substitution in the retained 18-call context. This PR emits the local word; global index/hash descriptors and a fresh compiler receipt must be rebuilt before source admission. The source native/ROW, ownership, precision, compiler and analytic assumptions remain. No global circuit optimum is claimed.

Package: `research/g20-four-role-resynthesis`. Replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-four-role-resynthesis`.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5804). Credit Dugongue, ai-nanachi, PR5679/5708, the PR5793 exact synthesis tool and all retained source lineage. Source head `829d01fc031f7323ffcfa423fdfd1f24dcbe3190`. Self-contained frozen bytes avoid any dependency on an unmerged Git object.


Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `9f80a2dfc160351e49ea82d3b3d9354d7329ead8`.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained tool and mathematical predecessor credits apply. No selected-frontier change.

Hosted [planning run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40411560192/job/121883269336) ran 511 tests and failed only in the unchanged revision-8 assignment tests: eight failures and two errors, with 22 platform skips. The scientific replay was skipped. The separate repair is PR5761; this PR does not duplicate it or claim hosted scientific success.
